dedupe_keys.name: aree riservate alla sosta del bike sharing

description: Aree riservate alla sosta del bike sharing is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Regione Toscana. Per semplificare l’utilizzo del nuovo servizio di bike sharing da parte degli utenti, l’Amministrazione del Comune di Firenze ha predisposto una serie di spazi riservati alla sosta. Il dataset contiene tali aree e in questo periodo di lancio del servizio è aggiornato frequentemente. Coverage: Regione Toscana. The portal files it under the publisher Regione Toscana. Its tags are bike-sharing, ciclabilita, comune-firenze, eu, opendata. It offers 3 resource(s) in GEOJSON, SHP, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-19 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
